import json, subprocess, sys, threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0))
        body = self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8")
        print("SERVER SAW:", self.path, body, file=sys.stderr)
        resp = {"ok": True, "channel": "C123", "ts": "1.1"}
        payload = json.dumps(resp).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(payload)

srv = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
port = srv.server_address[1]
threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "slack_api.py", "chat.postMessage", "channel=C123", "text=hello", "--api-url", "http://127.0.0.1:%d" % port], capture_output=True, text=True, env={"SLACK_TOKEN": "xoxb-test", "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin"})
print("RC:", proc.returncode)
print("STDOUT:", repr(proc.stdout))
print("STDERR:", repr(proc.stderr))
srv.shutdown()
EOF
